notes: No CREDITS.md. README says every beat is synthesized by the repo's own tools/perform.py (boom bap, trap, R&B, house, lo-fi; kick, snare, hat, 808, chords); songs defined in tools/songs.py. perform.py writes audio/sfx/beat_<id>.mp3 = the instrumental beat alone, played as a sample at the start of each 30 s performance (js/films/rap1.js line 76: sfx('sample', S.beatFile)). 'orig' is therefore our description, not copied from a credits file. Each file is ~30-34 s (audio/perf.json len: kaiwen 32.5, jinhua 33.6, paomian 32.5, ajie 34.1, max 32.6, youyu 30.1, josh 32.9, jasper 32.5), plays once, not looped.
